title: Vesuvius
novel:
On the morning of the wedding, Lily and Robin had a [[fight|fight]]. Robin accused Lily of being too [[controlling|controlling]] and not respecting her decisions. Lily felt [[hurt|hurt]] and told Robin she was only trying to help. The argument [[escalated|escalate]] quickly, and soon both women were in tears.

Meanwhile, Barney [[freaked|freak]] out about his wedding [[suit|suit]]. He was convinced that the suit was not perfect enough for the big day. He tried on dozens of suits and could not decide which one to wear. Ted tried to [[calm|calm]] him down, but Barney was too anxious to listen.

The gang also watched a [[forbidden|forbidden]] movie that Marshall had brought. It was a silly old film that they had promised never to watch again because it always caused arguments. Of course, watching it [[caused|cause]] exactly the kind of arguments they had expected.

Robin and Lily's fight reminded everyone of the volcano Mount Vesuvius. Once it erupted, there was no stopping it. But just like a volcano, the anger eventually [[subsided|subside]]. Robin and Lily [[apologized|apologize]] to each other and [[hugged|hug]].

Barney finally chose a [[classic|classic]] suit with Ted's help. It was a black suit that looked perfect on him. He felt [[confident|confident]] and ready to marry Robin. Ted told him he looked like the luckiest man in the world.

As the wedding hour approached, the gang gathered together. Despite all the [[drama|drama]] and chaos of the morning, everyone was [[excited|excite]] about the ceremony. Barney and Robin were about to take the biggest step of their lives, and their friends were there to support them every step of the way.

hurt.en: She felt hurt by his words.

freak.en: He freaked out about the test.
